title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for the s-wave cross section, sigma_t = (4π/k^2) sin^2(kR).

title: Wave Function Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the radial wave function for the s-wave, R_0(r) = chi_0(r)/r, and correctly apply the Schrödinger equation.

title: Continuity Condition
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the continuity condition at r = R to find the relationship involving delta_0.

title: Low Energy Approximation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the low energy limit where k approaches 0 and relate it to the total cross-section, sigma_t = 4πR^2.

title: High Energy Behavior
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the behavior of the cross-section at high energies, indicating that sigma_t approaches 0.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the expression for delta_0 or in the sine function evaluations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation, particularly in the expression for k.
